method.frp: Python port of src/sim/frp.ts (pass = satellite x 10-min bin; hold to next pass in the cell, max 12 h; GFAS beta by cover; IPCC EFs as in the app)
method.detections: FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP country archive (Indonesia), type 0 only, FRP > 0; NOAA-20/21 not used
method.cover: peat = GFW peatland tile alpha > 0 (z12 for the cells, z10 country-wide); else ESA WorldCover 2021 at 80 m (overview x8)
method.gfed4: GFED4.1s via GEOS-Chem mirror http://geoschemdata.wustl.edu/ExtData/HEMCO/GFED4/v2023-03/ (monthly DM_* kg m-2 s-1 x daily fractions); 2017+ is the 'beta' version scaled from MODIS active fires
